_comment: Front/back stock split shown as Back/Front columns in the dashboard's stock tabs (Critical, Low, Healthy, All products). PilotLive's feed only gives ONE combined total (SOH) per product, so the front (in-bar) vs back (storeroom) split is maintained here from the daily prep-sheet count. Keys = PilotLive product names (same format as pars.json). Values = {"back": <storeroom qty>, "front": <in-bar qty>}. Set _as_of to the count date. Example: "be - amstel": {"back": 24, "front": 11}. Products left out render blank (—) back/front; the SOH column stays live from PilotLive.
